description: Synthetic static-contract walkthroughs, not executable decisions, model evaluation or live-provider qualification.

cases.given: A selected-base census spans three pages. A peer Maintainer authored one PR; another has only a bot COMMENTED review and an author-association label. One role lookup and the last page fail.
cases.expected: Include the peer author, exclude only drafts/self-review within this mode, keep census/roles unknown and inspect actual qualified current CODEOWNER coverage. Supply assigned missing review rather than exempt all Maintainers or trust bot/count evidence.

references/maintainer-mode.md: all open PRs targeting the selected bases
across all pages, excluding drafts and the acting reviewer's own PRs
Include other Maintainer authors.
Partial census and unknown roles remain unknown
not an author-association label or a globally assumed permission-to-role mapping
this role supplies the missing review unless another eligible Maintainer already provides valid coverage
A bot's COMMENTED review is not qualified Maintainer approval.
SKILL.md: reevaluate actual qualified current coverage and review blocks on every sweep

cases.given: The adopted Maintainer role reviews a peer's PR. Native bot findings were already fixed; one governance recommendation remains, while required CI fails. No blocking-peer override is declared.
cases.expected: Verify fixes without reposting line findings, offer an advisory recommendation rather than CHANGE_REQUESTS, and leave the actual CI gate intact. Never fabricate approval; a different declared repository posture governs only when explicitly selected.

references/maintainer-mode.md: Generic reviewers do not inherit it.
advisory and nonblocking by default
An explicit repository/operator policy may select a blocking posture instead
Advisory posture never means fabricated approval or waived CI
complement native bot functional/line review with the adopted vision, architecture and governance lens
Verify whether existing findings were addressed

cases.given: A PR author lacks merge permission. One repository accepts ready submission as consent; another requires an additional signal. A static review lane has finished and the coordinator has an existing authorized completion adapter.
cases.expected: The coordinator performs normal authorized completion only after current policy gates and the applicable consent rule pass. Do not invent extra consent in the first repository or supply it in the second. The lane never merges, edits the author's branch or takes resources.

references/maintainer-mode.md: The Maintainer coordinator also owns normal authorized landing
classified using the repository's actual role vocabulary
Static reviewer lanes never become mergers, fix authors or resource owners.
refresh current head, required qualified reviews, CI, threads, mergeability, draft/hold/security state and author consent
Submission alone is not consent where additional consent is required
do not invent a universal extra approval or label
Preserve self-merge profiles and human-owned gates.
An adapter refusal is not permission for arbitrary administrative bypass.

cases.given: A review POST and GET both bind head A; the author then pushes B before the next sweep. The provider has no server freshness fence.
cases.expected: Retain the original effect and commit bindings as historical, refresh actual native opinion and qualified coverage on B, review the justified delta and supply required current review. Do not edit the receipt, manually rebind or blindly retry the write.

references/maintainer-mode.md: Every sweep reevaluates whether actual review authority is **current**
an author can push immediately after either
Keep immutable original POST responses and GET commit bindings.
Never manually rebind a review or rewrite its receipt to the newer head.
Refresh current head/discussion/check state and the native non-dismissed official opinion plus qualified coverage.
keep the effect historical
supply missing current review when actual gates require it
record the non-atomic race

cases.given: Lineage and patch/tree equivalence prove a clean rebase with unaffected dependencies, policy and discussion. The source finding is unchanged, but policy dismisses the old vote and the author explicitly requests review of the newer head, which has no official review yet.
cases.expected: Retain valid assessment without full analysis/reposted findings, but provide the first required official newer-head review through the retained reviewer. Mechanical rebase does not reset caps or authorize identical own votes on an unchanged current head.

references/maintainer-mode.md: Prove lineage and patch/tree equivalence
dependencies, policy and discussion
A SHA change alone is not changed intent.
Separately honor actual dismissal, latest-push, CODEOWNER and native-head requirements, and explicit author re-review requests.
A first official review on a requested newer head may be needed even when its finding is unchanged.
Never repeat an identical own vote on an unchanged current head without qualifying new input.
A mechanical rebase does not reset round, time or failure caps.
references/throughput-and-loops.md: retain source assessment without a full rerun
fulfill actual newer-head gates or explicit re-review requests

cases.given: The coordinator responds, discovery is absent, its queue is stale and activation is held. A manual review succeeded previously.
cases.expected: Keep current discovery health unknown, not authenticated-empty or an auth outage. Escalate the concrete held dependency once; continue only supported authorized independent manual work.

references/setup-and-adapters.md: A prior successful manual review proves historical capability, not current liveness.
An absent process alone is not an authentication outage.
condition, evidence, impact, next owner, resumption condition and default path.
An unanswered approval form is not approval
manual review can continue for unattempted eligible retained candidates

cases.given: A malformed local argument is rejected before invocation. A corrected argument is available within the existing mandate.
cases.expected: Make one bounded corrected attempt without a new permission ceremony; preserve the original clocks and budget. If invocation is uncertain, reconcile instead.

references/setup-and-adapters.md: correct the caller input within existing authority and make one bounded corrected attempt.
If invocation may have occurred, preserve the unknown effect and reconcile it first
references/throughput-and-loops.md: A bounded local assembly correction is not permission to reset the original attempt window.

cases.given: A read operation exits zero but embeds an access error. An unrelated operation family still works.
cases.expected: Stop the affected operation, not the whole role. Keep source membership unknown and do not retry unchanged on a timer. Any changed-input attempt stays bounded.

references/setup-and-adapters.md: including provider errors embedded in an exit-zero response.
Do not retry unchanged on a timer or blanket-block unrelated working operation families.
Preserve the original failure, clocks, attempt budget and unknown effects

cases.given: One enumeration returns no captured body; another successfully returns complete scoped pagination with no candidates or provider error.
cases.expected: The first source is unknown. Only the second establishes a healthy empty population, which still does not complete a continuous role.

references/setup-and-adapters.md: claim an empty population only after a successful, complete scoped enumeration with no provider error.
Empty/unknown capture, partial pages or a success footer alone never establish an empty source.
references/throughput-and-loops.md: A zero actionable queue in continuous mode means idle and observing, not complete.

cases.given: A reviewer closes its own thread after a bounded delta assessment. The receipt is accepted but clearing the pending marker fails, then the receipt is delivered again.
cases.expected: Retain the actual delta/finding coverage and uncertainty, not full-review credit. Reconcile the accepted revision and pending marker without double counting or reposting.

references/coordination-and-recovery.md: A bounded delta or closure of the reviewer's own thread does not earn credit for a fresh full review
Receipt integration and its pending-result marker must refer to the same accepted state revision
A repeated delivery must not count twice.

cases.given: A result awaits acceptance, an eligible vacancy exists, retained source is still applicable and only a final status snapshot is timed.
cases.expected: Accept and refill before optional dashboard work, reuse valid evidence and keep unmeasured intervals unknown. Do not reset original clocks or infer the slow phase from the snapshot.

references/throughput-and-loops.md: Prioritize returned-result acceptance and eligible lane refill before optional dashboard work.
Reuse applicable retained source and findings
A status snapshot or elapsed wall time alone cannot identify the bottleneck

cases.given: The operator selected a minimum available capacity. Cold review_actions is empty, but a complete census includes a retained author reply; some configured slots cannot accept work.
cases.expected: Report actual available and running capacity plus the shortage, qualify the retained follow-up and refill promptly. Neither empty cold actions nor configured slots prove completion or capacity.

references/throughput-and-loops.md: A cold `review_actions` list is only one intake signal, not the complete census
not a count of retained handles, configured slots or blocked admissions
without waiting for another cold action
retain the minimum and report the shortage

cases.given: Foreign review coverage is unclear, the aggregate is null and this role has authority and complete inputs for a warranted independent review.
cases.expected: Provide an honest own review without waiting for foreign coverage to become clear. Do not force approval, duplicate an unchanged own vote or infer completion from null aggregate state.

references/maintainer-mode.md: not a reason to defer this role's otherwise authorized, warranted independent review
not a demand to force a positive verdict
source assessment, individual native opinion and aggregate `reviewDecision` distinct
unknown is neither approval nor a veto

cases.given: COMMENTED is accepted by one verdict policy, an old APPROVED vote is now DISMISSED and a different reviewer still has CHANGES_REQUESTED findings.
cases.expected: Apply the actual target policy to each obligation. A nonblocking comment does not supply approving CODEOWNER coverage; dismissed votes are historical and another approval cannot silently clear a real blocker.

references/maintainer-mode.md: not an approving CODEOWNER vote where one is required
neither another approval nor a passing aggregate silently clears them
do not count the dismissed native vote as live coverage

cases.given: The role is stopped with one owned watch, another role's schedule, an uncertain post, useful WIP and an open author-owned PR.
cases.expected: Stop only owned flows, reconcile the uncertain effect and transfer remaining work through a tracked objective or accepted custodian. Keep records and PR custody; report unsettled obligations.

references/coordination-and-recovery.md: stop only this role's owned watches, schedules and nudges
merely naming a proposed recipient is not accepted custody.
Closing the role does not delete records/resources, abandon an open PR
not a promise of runtime-enforced cleanup.
